purpose: Strengthen ordinary baseline against phrase-quotation artifacts; preserve all original results.
timing: After initial corrected comparator inspection; no diagnosis or term changes. Exact filesystem timestamp/hash recorded in freeze-provenance.json.
queries: For each frozen diagnosis run the same ordinary synonym list with each phrase unquoted and parenthesized, once in BasicSearch and once in EligibilitySearch.
decision_rule: Any candidate found by this sensitivity baseline cannot be called missed by ordinary synonyms. No source results will be removed.
